```{r qq-eacd-selected-specs}
# =============================================================================
#  EACD, three specific (asset, order) cells: GBP/USD(2,1), BTCUSDT(2,2),
#  NVDA(2,2). Same OLS quantile-quality check as qq-wacd-selected-spec /
#  qq-lacd2-selected-specs, PLUS mean_resid explicitly, to separate the two
#  distinct things a QQ plot conflates:
#
#    SCALE:  if eps_hat = x/psi_hat does not average to 1 (Exp(1)'s own
#            mean), the empirical quantiles are a uniformly SCALED multiple
#            of Exp(1)'s -- sample ~ mean_resid * theoretical, a straight
#            line through the origin with slope = mean_resid. Points sitting
#            OFF the 45-degree line for this reason are not evidence of
#            distributional MISFIT; they are the residuals not being
#            centred at 1 in this finite sample.
#    SHAPE:  everything left over once scale is accounted for -- curvature,
#            tail departure from a straight line -- is the part the 45-
#            degree comparison is actually meant to diagnose.
#
#  Reading the table: mean_resid far from 1 with slope also far from 1 (and
#  close to mean_resid itself), intercept~0, and R2 still high, means "right
#  shape, wrong scale" -- a mean-equation centring issue, not a
#  distributional one. slope far from 1 while mean_resid is close to 1, or a
#  low R2/large max_abs_dev, means genuine shape misfit.
# =============================================================================
qq_winners_eacd <- list(
  list(asset = "GBP/USD", order = "(2,1)"),
  list(asset = "BTCUSDT", order = "(2,2)"),
  list(asset = "NVDA",    order = "(2,2)")
)

qq_winner_eacd_results <- lapply(qq_winners_eacd, function(w) {
  f <- order_fits[[w$order]][[w$asset]]
  if (is.null(f)) {
    cat(sprintf("EACD(%s) -- %s: NO CONVERGED FIT at this order -- cannot check.\n", w$order, w$asset))
    return(NULL)
  }
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  d <- qq_data_one(f, "exponential")
  if (is.null(d)) {
    cat(sprintf("EACD(%s) -- %s: too few finite residuals -- cannot check.\n", w$order, w$asset))
    return(NULL)
  }
  d[, `:=`(asset = w$asset, order = w$order)]
  q <- qq_fit_quality(d)
  q[, `:=`(asset = w$asset, order = w$order, mean_resid = round(mean(e), 4))]
  list(plot_data = d, quality = q)
})
qq_winner_eacd_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), qq_winner_eacd_results)

if (length(qq_winner_eacd_results) > 0) {
  qq_winner_eacd_data    <- rbindlist(lapply(qq_winner_eacd_results, `[[`, "plot_data"))
  qq_winner_eacd_quality <- rbindlist(lapply(qq_winner_eacd_results, `[[`, "quality"))
  qq_winner_eacd_data[, panel := sprintf("EACD(%s) - %s", order, asset)]

  print(
    ggplot(qq_winner_eacd_data, aes(x = theoretical, y = sample)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.4, colour = "darkgreen") +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
      labs(title    = "EACD: GBP/USD(2,1), BTCUSDT(2,2), NVDA(2,2)",
           subtitle = "Red dashed line = perfect fit (45 degrees), i.e. mean_resid = 1",
           x = "Theoretical quantile", y = "Empirical (sample) quantile") +
      theme_minimal()
  )

  cat("\n=== Quantitative fit check: EACD, GBP/USD(2,1)/BTCUSDT(2,2)/NVDA(2,2) ===\n\n")
  print(qq_winner_eacd_quality[, .(asset, order, mean_resid, R2, slope, intercept, max_abs_dev)], row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nREADING IT: mean_resid should be close to 1 -- if it is not, slope will\n")
  cat("track mean_resid rather than 1, and that gap is a SCALE artefact, not\n")
  cat("shape misfit (see this chunk's own note above). Only once mean_resid\n")
  cat("and slope are both close to 1 does a low R2, non-zero intercept, or\n")
  cat("large max_abs_dev indicate genuine distributional shape misfit.\n")
} else {
  cat("None of the three specified (asset, order) cells had a converged fit to check.\n")
}
```

```{r acf-helpers}

#  ACF of standardised residuals -- the companion check to the QQ plots
#  above: QQ addresses distributional SHAPE (does eps_hat look Exp(1)/
#  Weibull?), this addresses whether the fitted mean equation has actually
#  removed the serial dependence ACD exists to model (does eps_hat look
#  like white noise?). Same placement convention as the QQ helpers/plots --
#  one shared chunk of functions, defined once here (depends on nothing but
#  qq_orders, already defined in qq-helpers), then one small plotting chunk
#  per model family sitting right next to that family's own QQ plot, so a
#  model section (fit -> QQ -> ACF) can be run and knitted on its own.
#
#  eps_hat = f$residuals (ACDm's own x/psi_hat), NOT the raw duration --
#  an ACF of raw durations would just re-show the clustering the model was
#  fitted to remove; the question here is whether anything is LEFT after
#  fitting.
#
#  WHITE-NOISE BAND: +-1.96/sqrt(n), the standard large-sample 95% band for
#  an ACF under the null of no autocorrelation -- computed PER (asset,
#  order) PANEL from that panel's own residual count n, not one constant
#  band reused everywhere (n varies enormously across assets: FX droplet-
#  scale TRAIN vs BTC/NVDA million-plus).
#
#  square=TRUE: ACF of eps_hat^2 instead of eps_hat -- the same object
#  build_resid_diag_by_order's own LB_resid_sq column already tests via a
#  single Ljung-Box statistic (e^2, ARCH-style remaining volatility
#  clustering), now shown lag-by-lag instead of as one number. A model can
#  pass the plain-eps ACF check (dynamics of the LEVEL removed) while still
#  failing this one (dynamics of the SCALE/dispersion not removed) -- the
#  two are genuinely different questions, same distinction LB_resid vs
#  LB_resid_sq already draws in every order-selection table in this
#  document.

acf_resid_one <- function(f, max_lag = LB_LAGS, square = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e)]
  if (square) e <- e^2
  n <- length(e)
  if (n < max_lag * 4) return(NULL)
  a <- as.numeric(acf(e, lag.max = max_lag, plot = FALSE)$acf)[-1]
  data.table(lag = seq_along(a), acf = a, n = n)
}

acf_plot_family <- function(fits, family_name, max_lag = LB_LAGS, square = FALSE) {
  acf_mf <- rbindlist(lapply(qq_orders, function(ord) {
    fits_ord <- fits[[ord]]
    if (is.null(fits_ord)) return(NULL)
    rbindlist(lapply(names(fits_ord), function(nm) {
      d <- acf_resid_one(fits_ord[[nm]], max_lag, square = square)
      if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)
      d[, `:=`(asset = nm, order = ord)]
      d
    }))
  }))

  if (is.null(acf_mf) || nrow(acf_mf) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("%s: no converged fits at any order -- skipping residual-ACF plot.\n", family_name))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  bands <- unique(acf_mf[, .(asset, order, n)])[, band := 1.96 / sqrt(n)]
  acf_mf <- merge(acf_mf, bands[, .(asset, order, band)], by = c("asset", "order"))

  resid_label <- if (square) "standardised residuals squared (Q_resid)" else "standardised residuals"

  print(
    ggplot(acf_mf, aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "steelblue") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = band),  colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -band), colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_grid(asset ~ order, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(title    = sprintf("%s - ACF of %s, all orders", family_name, resid_label),
           x = "Lag", y = "ACF") +
      theme_minimal() + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
  )
  invisible(acf_mf)
}

cat("READING IT (applies to every per-model residual-ACF plot below): bars\n")
cat("inside the red dashed band at every lag = the fitted mean equation has\n")
cat("removed detectable serial dependence from the standardised residuals --\n")
cat("the companion read to the QQ plots' own distributional-shape check.\n")
cat("Bars sticking out past the band, especially at short lags, mean genuine\n")
cat("duration clustering survives the fit -- a dynamics problem (order too\n")
cat("low, wrong recursion) rather than an innovation-distribution problem,\n")
cat("which is what the QQ plot for the same panel would instead flag. A\n")
cat("missing (asset, order) panel means that combination did not converge --\n")
cat("see that model's own order-selection table for why. Calling\n")
cat("acf_plot_family(..., square = TRUE) instead runs the same check on\n")
cat("eps_hat^2 -- remaining volatility/dispersion clustering (ARCH-style),\n")
cat("the lag-by-lag companion to LB_resid_sq elsewhere in this document,\n")
cat("distinct from plain eps_hat's level-dynamics check above.\n")
```

```{r}

suppressMessages({ library(data.table); library(ggplot2) })

dens_specs <- list(
  list(label = "EACD(2,2) -- GBP/USD", f = order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["GBP/USD"]], dist = "exponential"),
  list(label = "EACD2(2,2) -- BTCUSDT", f = order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["BTCUSDT"]], dist = "exponential"),
  list(label = "EACD2(2,2) -- NVDA",    f = order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["NVDA"]],    dist = "exponential")
)

# Empirical residuals, trimmed at the 99th percentile per spec (a few
# extreme residuals otherwise squash the histogram's x-axis and hide the
# body of the distribution, which is what this plot is meant to show).
dens_plot_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(dens_specs, function(s) {
  if (is.null(s$f)) { cat(sprintf("%s: NO CONVERGED FIT -- skipped.\n", s$label)); return(NULL) }
  e <- as.numeric(s$f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cap <- quantile(e, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  data.table(panel = s$label, resid = e[e <= cap])
}))

# Theoretical density curve, same distribution/params each fit actually used.
dens_curve_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(dens_specs, function(s) {
  if (is.null(s$f)) return(NULL)
  e <- as.numeric(s$f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cap <- quantile(e, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  xs <- seq(0.001, cap, length.out = 300)
  ys <- if (s$dist == "weibull") {
    gam <- unname(s$f$dPara["gamma"])
    dweibull(xs, shape = gam, scale = 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam))   # forceErrExpec: E[eps]=1
  } else {
    dexp(xs, rate = 1)
  }
  data.table(panel = s$label, x = xs, y = ys)
}))

ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(data = dens_plot_dat, aes(x = resid, y = after_stat(density)),
                  bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens_curve_dat, aes(x = x, y = y), colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title    = "Density overlay: standardised residuals vs theoretical distribution",
       subtitle = "Histogram = empirical eps_hat (trimmed at 99th pct); red = theoretical density (Exp(1) or Weibull(gamma_hat))",
       x = "Standardised residual (eps_hat = x / psi_hat)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 3.5 The Weibull ACD Model

```{r wacd-fit}

#  WACD(1,1) - Weibull ACD.  E&R (1998) eq.(20).
#
#  WHY: the excess-dispersion test REJECTED Exp(1) on all three assets. 
#  Weibull is tried next as it gives an additional shape parameter.
#
#  THE CHANGE: same mean recursion, different error distribution.
#      x_i = psi_i * eps_i,  psi_i = omega + alpha*x_{i-1} + beta*psi_{i-1}
#      eps_i ~ Weibull(gamma), rescaled so E[eps] = 1
#
#  ONE extra parameter, gamma, the SHAPE:
#      gamma = 1 -> Weibull IS the exponential (EACD nested inside WACD)
#      gamma < 1 -> DECREASING hazard: the longer an event has been awaited,
#                   the less likely it becomes in the next instant. Heavier
#                   right tail than the exponential.
#      gamma > 1 -> increasing hazard.
#
#  PARAMETER SLOTS. ACDm splits parameters across two places:
#      mPara -> mean equation  (omega, alpha1, beta1)
#      dPara -> distribution   (gamma, the Weibull shape)
#    Npar = 4 counts both.


#  Checks if the model is already cached and can be used again.

if (!fit_ready("wacd_fits")) {
wacd_fits <- list()

for (nm in names(split_sets)) {

  x <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)        # SAME block as EACD; comparability
  cat(sprintf("\n=== WACD(1,1): %s (n = %s) ===\n",
              nm, format(length(x), big.mark = ",")))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    acdFit(durations = x, model = "ACD", dist = "weibull", order = c(1, 1),
           forceErrExpec = TRUE, output = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  default optimiser failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })

  # WACD adds a shape parameter, so the likelihood is stiffer than EACD's.
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    cat("  retrying with nlminb...\n")
    fit <- tryCatch(
      acdFit(durations = x, model = "ACD", dist = "weibull", order = c(1, 1),
             optimFnc = "nlminb", forceErrExpec = TRUE, output = FALSE),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  nlminb also failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
  }

  wacd_fits[nm] <- list(fit)   # [nm]<-list() not [[nm]]<- : preserves a NULL (failed-fit) entry
}
save_model_progress(wacd_fits = wacd_fits)
}

stopifnot(!any(vapply(wacd_fits, is.null, logical(1))))
```


```{r wacd-table}

# Code chunk to display the parameters obtained from WACD(1,1)

wacd_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  w  <- wacd_fits[[nm]]; e <- eacd_fits[[nm]]
  pw <- w$mPara;         pe <- e$mPara

  data.table(
    asset     = nm,
    omega_W   = round(unname(pw["omega"]),  5),
    alpha_W   = round(unname(pw["alpha1"]), 4),
    beta_W    = round(unname(pw["beta1"]),  4),
    persist_W = round(unname(pw["alpha1"] + pw["beta1"]), 4),
    gamma     = round(unname(w$dPara["gamma"]), 4),      # <- dPara
    persist_E = round(unname(pe["alpha1"] + pe["beta1"]), 4),
    logLik_W  = round(gof(w, "LogLikelihood"), 1),
    logLik_E  = round(gof(e, "LogLikelihood"), 1),
    AIC_W     = round(gof(w, "AIC"), 1),
    AIC_E     = round(gof(e, "AIC"), 1)
  )
}))

cat("=== WACD(1,1) against EACD(1,1) ===\n\n")
print(wacd_tbl)

cat("\n=== PARAMETER INFERENCE (note the gamma row: H0 is gamma = 1) ===\n")
for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
  cat("\n---", nm, "---\n")
  print(round(wacd_fits[[nm]]$parameterInference, 5))
}

cat("\n\nREADING IT:\n")
cat("  gamma < 1 on every asset -> DECREASING hazard. Activity alternates\n")
cat("  between sustained bursts and sustained lulls rather than proceeding at a\n")
cat("  steady rate. The exponential is rejected a SECOND time, now by a test on\n")
cat("  the distributional parameter itself, having already been rejected by a\n")
cat("  test on the moments of the standardised residuals. Two independent\n")
cat("  routes, one conclusion.\n")
```

```{r residual-mean}

#  The residual mean of WACD should be 1. 
#  One-sample Z-test for H0: E[eps] = 1.
#  If [z]>1.96 will be higher  for almost any non zero deviations.
#  Therefore the threshold of |mean(residual) - 1| > 0.05 is used to show deviation.

for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
  rw <- as.numeric(wacd_fits[[nm]]$residuals); rw <- rw[is.finite(rw)]
  d <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)
  cat(sprintf("  %-8s: mean(resid) = %.4f  z = %+.1f  gamma = %.3f  logLik = %+.0f  %ssub-ms=%.1f%%\n",
      nm, mean(rw), resid_mean_z(rw), wacd_fits[[nm]]$dPara["gamma"],
      wacd_fits[[nm]]$goodnessOfFit["LogLikelihood","value"],
      ifelse(abs(mean(rw)-1)>0.05,"[CORRUPTED] ","[ok] "),
      100*mean(d<0.001)))
}


```


```{r wacd-orders-seed-functions}

# Similar to eacd-orders-seed-helpers chunk for WACD separately.

#  For order(2,2)

make_seed_22 <- function(nm, base_fits = eacd_fits) {
  p <- base_fits[[nm]]$mPara
  om <- unname(p["omega"]); a1 <- unname(p["alpha1"]); b1 <- unname(p["beta1"])
  shape <- unname(base_fits[[nm]]$dPara["gamma"])
  c(om, a1 * 0.95, a1 * 0.05, b1 * 0.85, b1 * 0.15, shape)
}

#  For orders (1,2) and (2,1)

make_seed_asym <- function(nm, order, base_fits = eacd_fits) {
  p  <- base_fits[[nm]]$mPara
  om <- unname(p["omega"]); a1 <- unname(p["alpha1"]); b1 <- unname(p["beta1"])
  shape <- unname(base_fits[[nm]]$dPara["gamma"])
  if (identical(order, c(1, 2))) c(om, a1, b1 * 0.85, b1 * 0.15, shape)
  else                            c(om, a1 * 0.95, a1 * 0.05, b1, shape)
}


fit_eacd_order <- function(order, dist = "exponential", base_fits = eacd_fits) {
  fits <- list(); status <- list()
  for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
    x    <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)
    seed <- make_seed_asym(nm, order, base_fits = base_fits)
    fit <- tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(
        acdFit(durations = x, model = "ACD", dist = dist,
               order = order, optimFnc = "nlminb", startPara = seed,
               optimFncArgs = list(control = list(eval.max = 1000, iter.max = 800)),
               forceErrExpec = (dist != "exponential"),
               output = FALSE),
        warning = function(w) {
          if (grepl("NA/NaN function evaluation", conditionMessage(w)))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        }),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    fits[nm]     <- list(fit)
    status[[nm]] <- if (is.null(fit)) "FAILED (evidence of over-parameterisation)" else "converged"
  }
  list(fits = fits, status = status)
}
```

```{r wacd-order-selection}
if (!fit_ready("wacd22_fits")) {
wacd22_fits <- list(); wacd22_status <- list()

for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
  x <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)
  cat(sprintf("\n=== WACD(2,2): %s (n = %s) ===\n", nm, format(length(x), big.mark = ",")))

  seed <- make_seed_22(nm, base_fits = wacd_fits)
  cat(sprintf("  seeded at (1,1)-extended: omega=%.4g a1=%.3f a2=%.3f b1=%.3f b2=%.3f gamma=%.3f\n",
              seed[1], seed[2], seed[3], seed[4], seed[5], seed[6]))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      acdFit(durations = x, model = "ACD", dist = "weibull", order = c(2, 2),
             optimFnc = "nlminb", startPara = seed, forceErrExpec = TRUE,
             optimFncArgs = list(control = list(eval.max = 1000, iter.max = 800)),
             output = FALSE),
      warning = function(w) {
        if (grepl("NA/NaN function evaluation", conditionMessage(w)))
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }),
    error = function(e) { cat("  FAILED to converge:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })

  wacd22_fits[nm]     <- list(fit)   # [nm]<-list() not [[nm]]<- : preserves a NULL (failed-fit) entry
  wacd22_status[[nm]] <- if (is.null(fit)) "FAILED (evidence of over-parameterisation)" else "converged"
}

cat("\n=== WACD (2,2) CONVERGENCE STATUS ===\n")

save_model_progress(wacd22_fits = wacd22_fits)
}

            length(converged_w), length(wacd22_fits)))

#  FULL ORDER-SELECTION GRID: WACD(1,1) / (1,2) / (2,1) / (2,2). k includes
```

```{r eacd-wacd-acf-lags-table}

#  RESIDUAL ACF AT SELECTED LAGS - EACD and WACD, every order, one table.
#  Same underlying acf() ACDm residuals already use for LB_resid throughout
#  this document, just read off at four specific lags (1, 5, 10, 50) instead
#  of collapsed into a single Ljung-Box statistic -- shows WHERE any residual
#  autocorrelation sits (short-lag vs long-lag), which LB_resid's single
#  number cannot.
#
#  acf_at_lags() is generalized (fits_list, lags, resid_fn) so it is called
#  once per model family instead of writing this out twice -- same "avoid
#  repetition" pattern as build_survivor_dt/build_order_grid above.

acf_at_lags <- function(fits_list, lags = c(1, 5, 10, 50), resid_fn = exp_resid) {
  rbindlist(lapply(names(fits_list), function(nm) {
    f <- fits_list[[nm]]
    lag_cols <- setNames(as.list(rep(NA_real_, length(lags))), paste0("Lag_", lags))
    if (is.null(f)) return(cbind(data.table(asset = nm), as.data.table(lag_cols)))

    e <- resid_fn(f)
    if (length(e) <= max(lags)) return(cbind(data.table(asset = nm), as.data.table(lag_cols)))

    a    <- acf(e, lag.max = max(lags), plot = FALSE)$acf   # a[1] is lag 0
    vals <- round(a[lags + 1], 4)
    cbind(data.table(asset = nm), as.data.table(setNames(as.list(vals), paste0("Lag_", lags))))
  }))
}

if (!exists("eacd_acf_lags_tbl", inherits = FALSE)) {
eacd_acf_lags_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(order_fits), function(ord)
  cbind(order = ord, acf_at_lags(order_fits[[ord]]))))
save_model_progress(eacd_acf_lags_tbl = eacd_acf_lags_tbl)
}

if (!exists("wacd_acf_lags_tbl", inherits = FALSE)) {
wacd_acf_lags_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(wacd_order_fits), function(ord)
  cbind(order = ord, acf_at_lags(wacd_order_fits[[ord]]))))
save_model_progress(wacd_acf_lags_tbl = wacd_acf_lags_tbl)
}

cat("=== Residual ACF at selected lags -- EACD, all four orders ===\n\n")

cat("\n=== Residual ACF at selected lags -- WACD, all four orders ===\n\n")

cat("is short-memory leftover dependence -- consistent with disp_stat/LB_resid's\n")
cat("own large-n-power caveat (present but not necessarily large). Lag 50 still\n")
cat("sizeable is the more concerning pattern: long-range dependence the mean\n")
cat("equation has not absorbed, regardless of order.\n")
```

```{r}

lb15 <- function(f, sq = FALSE, p = FALSE) {
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  if (length(e) <= LB_LAGS) return(NA_real_)
  bt <- Box.test(if (sq) e^2 else e, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  if (p) return(bt$p.value)
  unname(bt$statistic)
}
persist_of <- function(f) {
  p <- f$mPara
  unname(sum(p[grepl("^alpha", names(p))]) + sum(p[grepl("^beta", names(p))]))
}

build_order_grid <- function(order_fits, order_k, order_crit, baseline_fits) {
  rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
    rbindlist(lapply(names(order_fits), function(ord) {
      f <- order_fits[[ord]][[nm]]
      na_row <- function(verdict) data.table(
        asset = nm, order = ord, k = order_k[[ord]],
        logLik = NA_real_, AIC = NA_real_, BIC = NA_real_,
        persistence = NA_real_, LB_resid = NA_real_,
        LR = NA_real_, LR_crit = NA_real_, verdict = verdict)
      if (is.null(f)) return(na_row("FAILED to converge"))
      row <- tryCatch({
        ll <- gof(f, "LogLikelihood")
        lr <- lr_crit <- NA_real_; verdict <- "-- baseline --"
        if (ord != "(1,1)") {
          lr      <- 2 * (ll - gof(baseline_fits[[nm]], "LogLikelihood"))
          lr_crit <- order_crit[[ord]]
          verdict <- ifelse(lr > lr_crit, "sig. better than (1,1)", "NOT sig. better than (1,1)")
        }
        data.table(asset = nm, order = ord, k = order_k[[ord]],
                   logLik = round(ll, 1), AIC = round(gof(f, "AIC"), 1), BIC = round(gof(f, "BIC"), 1),
                   persistence = round(persist_of(f), 4), LB_resid = round(lb15(f), 1),
                   LR = round(lr, 2), LR_crit = lr_crit, verdict = verdict)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(row) || !is.finite(row$logLik)) return(na_row("converged but degenerate (non-finite fit)"))
      row
    }))
  }))
}

build_resid_diag_by_order <- function(order_fits, dist_label = "exponential") {
  rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
    rbindlist(lapply(names(order_fits), function(ord) {
      f <- order_fits[[ord]][[nm]]
      if (is.null(f))
        return(data.table(asset = nm, order = ord, n = NA_integer_,
                           LB_resid = NA_real_, LB_resid_p = NA_real_,
                           LB_resid_sq = NA_real_, LB_resid_sq_p = NA_real_,
                           mean_resid = NA_real_, mean_resid_z = NA_real_, sd_resid = NA_real_,
                           disp_stat = NA_real_, verdict = "FAILED to converge"))
      e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
      n <- length(e)
      if (n <= LB_LAGS)
        return(data.table(asset = nm, order = ord, n = n,
                           LB_resid = NA_real_, LB_resid_p = NA_real_,
                           LB_resid_sq = NA_real_, LB_resid_sq_p = NA_real_,
                           mean_resid = round(mean(e), 4), mean_resid_z = NA_real_, sd_resid = NA_real_,
                           disp_stat = NA_real_, verdict = "degenerate"))
      lb_e_t  <- Box.test(e,   lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
      lb_e2_t <- Box.test(e^2, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
      lb_e  <- unname(lb_e_t$statistic)
      lb_e2 <- unname(lb_e2_t$statistic)
      s2 <- var(e); sig_u <- sd((e - 1)^2)
      disp_stat <- sqrt(n) * (s2 - 1) / sig_u
      data.table(asset = nm, order = ord, n = n,
                 LB_resid = round(lb_e, 1), LB_resid_p = signif(lb_e_t$p.value, 3),
                 LB_resid_sq = round(lb_e2, 1), LB_resid_sq_p = signif(lb_e2_t$p.value, 3),
                 mean_resid = round(mean(e), 4), mean_resid_z = round(resid_mean_z(e), 1),
                 sd_resid = round(sd(e), 4),
                 disp_stat = round(disp_stat, 1),
                 verdict = ifelse(abs(disp_stat) > 1.96,
                                   sprintf("Var(eps)!=1 (not %s-consistent)", dist_label),
                                   sprintf("Var(eps)~1 (%s-consistent)", dist_label)))
    }))
  }))
}

```



```{r wacd-caveats}

#  TRUSTWORTHINESS FLAG per asset, referenced by every later WACD diagnostic
#  that restricts itself to non-corrupted fits (wacd-simulate, the residual-
#  independence table, the KS table). An asset is flagged corrupted on the
#  same criterion printed just above: standardised-residual mean departing
#  from 1 by more than 0.05, i.e. the sub-millisecond/duplicate-timestamp
#  mass has pulled the fit off its own identifying moment condition.

# `trustworthy` stays on the 0.05 magnitude rule -- it GATES whether later
# chunks (wacd-simulate, residual-independence) even run for an asset, and
# at this n a strict |z|>1.96 would fire on almost any nonzero deviation
# (same power problem as Ljung-Box at this scale), flagging even the clean
# reference case (GBP/USD) as untrustworthy. mean_resid_z is reported
# alongside for rigor, not as the gate.
wacd_check <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  rw <- as.numeric(wacd_fits[[nm]]$residuals); rw <- rw[is.finite(rw)]
  data.table(asset       = nm,
             mean_resid  = round(mean(rw), 4),
             mean_resid_z = round(resid_mean_z(rw), 1),
             trustworthy = ifelse(abs(mean(rw) - 1) > 0.05, "no", "yes"))
}))
print(wacd_check)
cat("\nmean_resid_z: one-sample Z-stat for H0 E[eps]=1, reported for rigor --\n")
cat("NOT the trustworthy gate (see comment above); read its MAGNITUDE, not\n")
cat("whether it clears 1.96.\n")
```

```{r survivor-curve}

#  SURVIVOR-FUNCTION DIAGNOSTIC (E&R Figure 5 analogue) -- generalised P-P form.
#
#  PREVIOUS VERSION plotted EMPIRICAL -log S(x) against the raw residual x for
#  BOTH models, on the reasoning that forceErrExpec pins E[eps]=1 for both.
#  That reasoning does not actually make x = -log S(x) the right line for
#  WACD: E[eps]=1 fixes the MEAN, not the SHAPE. Under Weibull(gamma, scale),
#      S(x) = exp(-(x/scale)^gamma)  =>  -log S(x) = (x/scale)^gamma,
#  which only equals x when gamma = 1 (i.e. WACD collapsed back to EACD).
#  Plotting WACD's residuals against x therefore tested them against Exp(1)
#  -- the very distribution WACD was fit to move AWAY from -- not against the
#  Weibull(gamma_hat) it was actually fit under. wacd-residual-gof's own KS
#  test already gets this right (tests against fitted Weibull); this plot did
#  not match it.
#
#  FIX -- generalised P-P plot: each model's residuals are checked against
#  ITS OWN fitted distribution's theoretical -log S(x), not a fixed x-axis:
#      EACD: theo = x                        (Exp(1): -log S(x) = x)
#      WACD: theo = (x / wscale)^gamma_hat    (fitted Weibull's own -log S(x))
#  Both axes are now "-log(survivor)", empirical (y) vs theoretical under the
#  model actually fitted (x) -- the dashed 45-degree line is the correct
#  reference for BOTH series simultaneously, and a departure from it means
#  the SAME thing for either model: the fitted distribution's own tail is
#  wrong, not "wrong relative to exponential specifically". This is the
#  direct visual form of wacd-residual-gof's/eacd-residual-gof's own KS
#  tests, just for both models overlaid on one plot -- exactly what E&R's own
#  Figure 5 does (residuals checked against the model's own fitted survivor
#  function, not a shared exponential yardstick).

library(ggplot2); library(data.table)

if (!exists("surv_dt", inherits = FALSE)) {
surv_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(eacd_fits), function(nm) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c("EACD","WACD"), function(mod) {
    f <- if (mod=="EACD") eacd_fits[[nm]] else wacd_fits[[nm]]
    e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
    e <- sort(e)
    n <- length(e)
    # empirical survivor at each ordered residual: S(e_(i)) = 1 - (i-0.5)/n
    S <- 1 - (seq_len(n) - 0.5)/n
    # keep the upper tail region where the divergence lives, thin for plotting
    keep <- e > quantile(e, 0.50)          # right half; tail is what matters
    idx  <- which(keep)
    idx  <- idx[seq(1, length(idx), length.out = min(2000, length(idx)))]
    e_kept <- e[idx]

    # theoretical -log S(x) under THIS model's own fitted distribution --
    # EACD: Exp(1), so theo = x. WACD: fitted Weibull(gamma_hat), rescaled
    # to unit mean the same way forceErrExpec/wacd-residual-gof do.
    theo <- if (mod == "EACD") {
      e_kept
    } else {
      gam    <- unname(f$dPara["gamma"])
      wscale <- 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam)
      (e_kept / wscale)^gam
    }

    data.table(asset = nm, model = mod,
               x = e_kept, theo = theo, neglogS = -log(S[idx]))
  }))
}))
save_model_progress(surv_dt = surv_dt)
}

ggplot(surv_dt, aes(theo, neglogS, colour = model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ asset, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("EACD" = "firebrick", "WACD" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(title    = "Survivor-function diagnostic on standardised residuals",
       subtitle = "Empirical -log S(x) vs each model's OWN theoretical -log S(x) (Exp(1) for EACD, fitted Weibull(gamma_hat) for WACD). On the dashed 45-degree line = that model's fitted tail is correct; bending ABOVE = empirical tail heavier than even ITS OWN fitted distribution allows.",
       x = "Theoretical -log S(x) under each model's own fit",
       y = expression(-log~hat(S)(x)~(empirical)),
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")

# ---- Overlapping histogram of standardised residuals, EACD vs WACD --------
# Same overlapping-density style as poisson-plot-dist/eacd-plot-dist/
# wacd-plot-dist, applied one level deeper: to standardised residuals rather
# than raw durations, since that's what this chunk is validating. Gives the
# full-distribution shape behind what the survivor-function plot and the
# tail-exceedance table quantify abstractly.
resid_hist_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(eacd_fits), function(nm) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c("EACD", "WACD"), function(mod) {
    f <- if (mod == "EACD") eacd_fits[[nm]] else wacd_fits[[nm]]
    e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
    data.table(asset = nm, model = mod, residual = e)
  }))
}))

ggplot(resid_hist_dt, aes(x = residual, fill = model)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 80,
                 position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = dexp, args = list(rate = 1), n = 500, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ asset, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EACD" = "firebrick", "WACD" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(title    = "Standardised residuals: EACD vs WACD, full distribution",
       subtitle = "Log x-axis, density scale. Dashed black = theoretical Exp(1) -- the common reference both models are tested against (forceErrExpec pins both to unit mean, same logic as the survivor-curve line above).",
       x = "Standardised residual (log scale)", y = "Density", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")

rm(resid_hist_dt); invisible(gc())

# ---- quantify the tail departure: observed vs expected exceedance ----
# Same fix as the plot above: EACD's expected % is under Exp(1) (fixed,
# every asset); WACD's is under ITS OWN fitted Weibull(gamma_hat) -- varies
# by asset since gamma does. A fixed Exp(1) expected value for WACD would
# repeat the exact mismatch just fixed in the survivor-curve plot.
cat("=== Right-tail exceedance: how many residuals beyond 2.5 s.d. (raw value 3.5)? ===\n")
cat("EACD expected under Exp(1): exp(-3.5) = ", round(100*exp(-3.5), 2), "%, every asset.\n")
cat("WACD expected under ITS OWN fitted Weibull(gamma_hat) -- varies by asset, printed below.\n\n")
tail_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(eacd_fits), function(nm) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c("EACD","WACD"), function(mod) {
    f <- if (mod=="EACD") eacd_fits[[nm]] else wacd_fits[[nm]]
    e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
    exp_pct <- if (mod == "EACD") {
      round(100 * exp(-3.5), 2)
    } else {
      gam    <- unname(f$dPara["gamma"])
      wscale <- 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam)
      round(100 * (1 - pweibull(3.5, shape = gam, scale = wscale)), 2)
    }
    data.table(asset = nm, model = mod,
               obs_pct_gt_3.5 = round(100*mean(e > 3.5), 2),
               exp_pct        = exp_pct)
  }))
}))
print(tail_tbl)
cat("\nObserved % beyond 3.5 vs each model's OWN fitted expected %. Higher observed\n")
cat("than expected = the empirical tail is heavier than even that model's own\n")
cat("fitted distribution allows -- not 'heavier than exponential' for WACD specifically.\n")
```



```{r wacd-residual-independence}

#  RESIDUAL INDEPENDENCE, mirroring eacd-residuals Tests 1-2 (LB on levels and
#  squares). NOT gated by trustworthy: whether a corrupted fit's residuals
#  still show leftover dependence is itself informative either way.
#
#  Test 3 (excess dispersion) is NOT repeated here -- fitting the Weibull
#  shape IS the fix for that test, and wacd-table's gamma<1 result already
#  confirms it directly. Re-running the EACD-style dispersion statistic here
#  would test WACD residuals against the WRONG reference distribution
#  (Exp(1), not Weibull(gamma)) -- that comparison belongs to wacd-residual-gof
#  below, done correctly against the fitted Weibull.

wacd_resid_indep <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  f <- wacd_fits[[nm]]
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  lb_e_t  <- Box.test(e,   lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  lb_e2_t <- Box.test(e^2, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  lb_e  <- unname(lb_e_t$statistic)
  lb_e2 <- unname(lb_e2_t$statistic)
  data.table(asset = nm, n = length(e),
             LB_resid = round(lb_e, 1), LB_resid_p = signif(lb_e_t$p.value, 3),
             LB_resid_sq = round(lb_e2, 1), LB_resid_sq_p = signif(lb_e2_t$p.value, 3),
             trustworthy = wacd_check[asset == nm]$trustworthy)
}))
cat("=== WACD(1,1) RESIDUAL INDEPENDENCE (chi-sq(15) crit = 25, p < .05) ===\n\n")
print(wacd_resid_indep)
cat("\nCompare directly against EACD's resid_diag (LB_resid/LB_resid_sq columns)\n")
cat("for the same assets -- the mean recursion is nominally the same structure,\n")
cat("so a large divergence from the EACD numbers would itself flag the\n")
cat("'corrupted fit' assets from a second, independent angle.\n")
```

```{r wacd-residual-gof}

#  FORMAL RESIDUAL GOODNESS-OF-FIT for WACD, mirroring eacd-residual-gof --
#  but tested against the FITTED Weibull(gamma_hat), not Exp(1). Different
#  question from EACD's: not "is exponential right" (already answered: no,
#  that's why WACD exists), but "is Weibull ITSELF an adequate shape."
#
#  Scale matches forceErrExpec's own rescaling (E&R eq.20 / ACDm internals):
#      scale = 1 / Gamma(1 + 1/gamma)
#  so the reference distribution has unit mean, consistent with how the model
#  was actually fitted.

wacd_gof_ks <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  f <- wacd_fits[[nm]]
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  gam <- unname(f$dPara["gamma"])
  wscale <- 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam)
  kt <- ks.test(e, "pweibull", shape = gam, scale = wscale)
  data.table(asset = nm, n = length(e), gamma = round(gam, 4),
             D_stat = round(unname(kt$statistic), 4), p_value = signif(kt$p.value, 3),
             verdict = ifelse(kt$p.value < 0.05, "REJECT Weibull(gamma_hat)", "not rejected"),
             trustworthy = wacd_check[asset == nm]$trustworthy)
}))
cat("=== KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TEST: WACD residuals against fitted Weibull ===\n\n")
print(wacd_gof_ks)
cat("\nCompare D against eacd-residual-gof's Exp(1) test for the same assets:\n")
cat("a SMALLER D here confirms Weibull is genuinely the better-fitting shape,\n")
cat("not just formally preferred by the LR/gamma test.\n")
```

```{r wacd-ecdf-plot}

#  EMPIRICAL CDF vs FITTED WEIBULL CDF -- visual confirmation of the near-zero
#  blow-up flagged by wacd-residual-gof's KS test and the residual-mean check
#  above. A PDF/histogram is unreadable here: the Weibull density itself
#  DIVERGES as x -> 0 when gamma < 1 (wacd-fit's own note), so a histogram
#  y-axis would need to scale to infinity at the origin. The CDF is bounded in
#  [0,1] by construction regardless of how the underlying density behaves, so
#  the same failure shows up instead as a finite, readable gap between the
#  empirical step function and the fitted curve -- exactly where the blow-up
#  happens, near 0.
#
#  Log x-axis: WACD residuals span several orders of magnitude (like the
#  durations they are built from), and the failure this plot exists to show
#  lives entirely in the near-zero region -- a linear axis would compress it
#  into an unreadable sliver against the plot's right-hand tail.
#
#  The KS D-statistic in wacd-residual-gof IS the maximum vertical distance
#  between these two curves; this plot shows WHERE that gap sits, not just its
#  size.

ecdf_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  f  <- wacd_fits[[nm]]
  rw <- as.numeric(f$residuals); rw <- rw[is.finite(rw) & rw > 0]
  data.table(asset = nm, resid = rw)
}))

# Fitted Weibull CDF, evaluated on a log-spaced grid per asset (own gamma/scale)
theo_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  f      <- wacd_fits[[nm]]
  gam    <- unname(f$dPara["gamma"])
  wscale <- 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam)
  rw     <- as.numeric(f$residuals); rw <- rw[is.finite(rw) & rw > 0]
  grid   <- exp(seq(log(min(rw)), log(max(rw)), length.out = 1000))
  data.table(asset = nm, resid = grid, cdf = pweibull(grid, shape = gam, scale = wscale))
}))

ggplot() +
  stat_ecdf(data = ecdf_dat, aes(x = resid, colour = "Empirical (residuals)"),
            geom = "step", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = theo_dat, aes(x = resid, y = cdf, colour = "Fitted Weibull(gamma_hat)"),
            linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Empirical (residuals)" = "black",
                                 "Fitted Weibull(gamma_hat)" = "red")) +
  facet_wrap(~ asset, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title    = "WACD(1,1): empirical CDF of residuals vs fitted Weibull CDF",
       subtitle = "Log x-axis. A gap near the origin = the near-zero density blow-up flagged by the KS test and residual mean above.",
       x = "Standardised residual (log scale)", y = "CDF", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")

cat("=== READING IT ===\n")
cat("GBP/USD (0% sub-ms, uncorrupted): the two curves should track closely --\n")
cat("this is the reference case for what an unproblematic fit looks like here.\n")
cat("BTCUSDT (11.1%) and NVDA (30.7%): expect visible separation concentrated\n")
cat("in the LOW-residual region -- the fitted Weibull, dragged toward gamma<1\n")
cat("by chasing the sub-ms mass, assigns the near-zero region a shape the\n")
cat("empirical residuals do not actually have.\n")
```


```{r wacd-near-zero-test}

#  DIRECT, QUANTIFIED TEST of the near-zero blow-up -- wacd-ecdf-plot only
#  shows this visually (and its own comment only PREDICTS the gap, doesn't
#  verify it with a number). This compares OBSERVED vs WEIBULL-PREDICTED
#  P(eps < c) at several small cutoffs, with a formal one-sample proportion
#  test at each - an actual number, not an eyeballed plot.

near_zero_cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10)

near_zero_test <- rbindlist(lapply(names(wacd_fits), function(nm) {
  f      <- wacd_fits[[nm]]
  gam    <- unname(f$dPara["gamma"])
  wscale <- 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam)
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  n <- length(e)

  rbindlist(lapply(near_zero_cutoffs, function(c) {
    obs_n <- sum(e < c)
    obs_p <- obs_n / n
    exp_p <- pweibull(c, shape = gam, scale = wscale)
    bt <- binom.test(obs_n, n, p = exp_p)
    data.table(asset = nm, cutoff = c, n = n,
               observed_pct = round(100 * obs_p, 3),
               weibull_predicted_pct = round(100 * exp_p, 3),
               ratio_obs_over_pred = round(obs_p / exp_p, 2),
               p_value = signif(bt$p.value, 3),
               verdict = ifelse(bt$p.value < 0.05, "REJECT (mismatch)", "not rejected"))
  }))
}))

cat("=== Near-zero mass: OBSERVED vs Weibull(gamma_hat)-PREDICTED P(eps < c) ===\n\n")
print(near_zero_test)

cat("\nREADING IT: if the fitted Weibull genuinely captured the near-zero\n")
cat("region, observed_pct and weibull_predicted_pct should be close, and\n")
cat("ratio_obs_over_pred should sit near 1.00. At this n (hundreds of\n")
cat("thousands to millions), p_value will read <0.05 for almost ANY nonzero\n")
cat("gap -- same large-N power issue as disp_stat/mean_resid_z elsewhere in\n")
cat("this document -- so read ratio_obs_over_pred's MAGNITUDE as the actual\n")
cat("evidence, not the p-value pass/fail. A ratio far from 1 is direct,\n")
cat("quantified proof that gamma was pulled to a value that does NOT\n")
cat("correctly describe how much mass actually sits near zero.\n")

```

```{r}


suppressMessages({ library(data.table) })

# WACD, ALL FOUR ORDERS: same complete-table format as logacd2_full_row/
# logacd_full_row (full parameters + AIC/BIC + residual diagnostics in one
# row per asset/order), adapted for WACD: persistence is LINEAR
# alpha(+alpha2)+beta1(+beta2) -- same convention as wacd_tbl's own
# persist_W and EACD's persist_of, NOT the beta-only convention LACD1/LACD2
# use (WACD's x_i = psi_i*eps_i genuinely carries psi_i-1's level forward,
# same reason as EACD) -- plus gamma (Weibull shape, from dPara).
wacd_full_row <- function(nm, ord, f) {
  na_row <- function(verdict, n = NA_integer_)
    data.table(
      asset = nm, order = ord, n = n, omega = NA_real_,
      alpha1 = NA_real_, alpha2 = NA_real_, beta1 = NA_real_, beta2 = NA_real_,
      gamma = NA_real_, persistence = NA_real_, logLik = NA_real_, AIC = NA_real_, BIC = NA_real_,
      mean_resid = NA_real_, mean_resid_z = NA_real_, sd_resid = NA_real_,
      disp_stat = NA_real_, var_eps_eq_1 = NA_character_,
      LB_resid = NA_real_, LB_resid_p = NA_real_, LB_resid_sq = NA_real_, LB_resid_sq_p = NA_real_,
      verdict = verdict)

  if (is.null(f)) return(na_row(if (ord == "(1,1)") "FAILED to converge" else "SKIPPED (no (1,1) baseline to seed from, or failed itself)"))
  p <- f$mPara
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]; n <- length(e)
  if (n <= LB_LAGS) return(na_row("degenerate (too few finite residuals for LB)", n = n))

  lb1_t <- Box.test(e,   lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  lb2_t <- Box.test(e^2, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  s2 <- var(e); sig_u <- sd((e - 1)^2); disp <- sqrt(n) * (s2 - 1) / sig_u

  a1 <- unname(p["alpha1"]); a2 <- if ("alpha2" %in% names(p)) unname(p["alpha2"]) else 0
  b1 <- unname(p["beta1"]);  b2 <- if ("beta2" %in% names(p)) unname(p["beta2"]) else 0

  data.table(
    asset = nm, order = ord, n = n,
    omega  = round(unname(p["omega"]), 5),
    alpha1 = round(a1, 4),
    alpha2 = if ("alpha2" %in% names(p)) round(a2, 4) else NA_real_,
    beta1  = round(b1, 4),
    beta2  = if ("beta2" %in% names(p)) round(b2, 4) else NA_real_,
    gamma  = round(unname(f$dPara["gamma"]), 4),
    persistence = round(a1 + a2 + b1 + b2, 4),
    logLik = round(gof(f, "LogLikelihood"), 1), AIC = round(gof(f, "AIC"), 1), BIC = round(gof(f, "BIC"), 1),
    mean_resid = round(mean(e), 4), mean_resid_z = round(resid_mean_z(e), 1), sd_resid = round(sd(e), 4),
    disp_stat = round(disp, 1),
    # Var(eps)=1 is automatic under exponential but NOT under Weibull (Var
    # depends on gamma) -- same caveat build_resid_diag_by_order's own
    # dist_label argument carries, labelled honestly rather than implying a
    # WACD residual "should" look exponential.
    var_eps_eq_1 = ifelse(abs(disp) > 1.96, "REJECTED (not Weibull(gamma_hat)-consistent on Var)", "not rejected"),
    LB_resid = round(unname(lb1_t$statistic), 1), LB_resid_p = signif(lb1_t$p.value, 3),
    LB_resid_sq = round(unname(lb2_t$statistic), 1), LB_resid_sq_p = signif(lb2_t$p.value, 3),
    verdict = "ok"
  )
}

wacd_full_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(wacd_order_fits), function(ord)
  rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm)
    wacd_full_row(nm, ord, wacd_order_fits[[ord]][[nm]])))), fill = TRUE)

cat("=== WACD, ALL FOUR ORDERS: parameters, gamma, AIC/BIC, residual diagnostics ===\n\n")
print(wacd_full_tbl, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nREADING IT: persistence here is alpha1(+alpha2)+beta1(+beta2), the LINEAR\n")
cat("convention (same as EACD/wacd_tbl's own persist_W) -- NOT beta-only like\n")
cat("LACD1/LACD2, since WACD's x_i=psi_i*eps_i genuinely carries psi_i-1's\n")
cat("level forward, same reason as EACD. gamma<1 = decreasing hazard (same\n")
cat("reading as wacd-table's own gamma column). A 'SKIPPED' verdict\n")
cat("propagating across all three richer orders for one asset traces back to\n")
cat("that asset's own WACD(1,1) baseline failing -- check wacd-fit's own\n")
cat("convergence report, not this table, for why.\n")

```

**Verdict — rung 5.** The Weibull specification establishes one result securely
and one provisionally. The secure result is the rejection of the exponential:
the shape parameter is significantly below unity on all three assets, so the
hazard is decreasing rather than constant. This confirms by a second and
independent route the conclusion reached from the excess-dispersion test. The
provisional result concerns the conditional mean: where the residual mean
departs from unity and the log-likelihood turns positive, the mean equation has
restructured in a manner traceable to the concentration of sub-millisecond
durations, and those persistence estimates are not comparable with the ones
obtained under the exponential. A specification modelling the *logarithm* of the
conditional mean (Bauwens & Giot, 2000) is not sensitive in the same way to a
mass of observations near zero, and would be the natural next step.

```{r}

wacd_order_fits     <- list("(1,1)"=wacd_fits,   "(1,2)"=wacd12_fits,   "(2,1)"=wacd21_fits,   "(2,2)"=wacd22_fits)
```

```{r qq-wacd-selected-spec}
#  This document's own recommendation per asset (sim_winner, Section 11):
#  WACD(2,2) for GBP/USD. Being the AIC/BIC/persistence winner among the
#  orders TRIED is not the same claim as "this is a good fit in absolute
#  terms" -- this chunk checks the second, weaker claim directly: does this
#  specific fit actually sit on the 45-degree line, or does it still show
#  real distributional misfit?
#
#  Quantitative companion to the visual: fit sample ~ theoretical by OLS.
#  A perfect QQ match has slope=1, intercept=0, R^2=1. max_abs_dev is the
#  single worst quantile-space gap, in the SAME units as duration (seconds,
#  standardised) - interpretable directly, unlike R^2 alone.

f <- wacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["GBP/USD"]]
d <- qq_data_one(f, "weibull")

if (is.null(d)) {
  cat("WACD(2,2) -- GBP/USD: NO CONVERGED FIT at this order -- cannot check.\n")
} else {
  q <- qq_fit_quality(d)

  print(
    ggplot(d, aes(x = theoretical, y = sample)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.4, colour = "darkgreen") +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      labs(title    = "Selected specification: WACD(2,2) for GBP/USD -- does the QQ fit actually support this as the chosen model?",
           subtitle = "This document's own recommendation (sim_winner, Section 11)",
           x = "Theoretical quantile", y = "Empirical (sample) quantile") +
      theme_minimal()
  )

  cat("\n=== Quantitative fit check: WACD(2,2) -- GBP/USD ===\n\n")
  print(q, row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nREADING IT: slope~1, intercept~0, R2 close to 1 = points sit\n")
  cat("essentially on the 45-degree line = good fit. R2 well below 1, or a\n")
  cat("slope/intercept far from 1/0, or a large max_abs_dev, means even the\n")
  cat("WINNING specification -- best by AIC/BIC/persistence among the orders\n")
  cat("tried -- still shows real distributional misfit. Compare directly\n")
  cat("against GBP/USD's row in the WACD per-model QQ plot above: this panel\n")
  cat("is that exact (asset, order) cell, pulled out and quantified on its own.\n")
}
```

```{r}
suppressMessages({ library(data.table); library(ggplot2) })

dens_specs <- list(
  list(label = "WACD(2,2) -- GBP/USD", f = wacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["GBP/USD"]], dist = "weibull"),
  list(label = "WACD2(2,2) -- BTCUSDT", f = wacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["BTCUSDT"]], dist = "weibull"),
  list(label = "WACD2(2,2) -- NVDA",    f = wacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["NVDA"]],    dist = "weibull")
)

# Empirical residuals, trimmed at the 99th percentile per spec (a few
# extreme residuals otherwise squash the histogram's x-axis and hide the
# body of the distribution, which is what this plot is meant to show).
dens_plot_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(dens_specs, function(s) {
  if (is.null(s$f)) { cat(sprintf("%s: NO CONVERGED FIT -- skipped.\n", s$label)); return(NULL) }
  e <- as.numeric(s$f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cap <- quantile(e, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  data.table(panel = s$label, resid = e[e <= cap])
}))

# Theoretical density curve, same distribution/params each fit actually used.
dens_curve_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(dens_specs, function(s) {
  if (is.null(s$f)) return(NULL)
  e <- as.numeric(s$f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cap <- quantile(e, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  xs <- seq(0.001, cap, length.out = 300)
  ys <- if (s$dist == "weibull") {
    gam <- unname(s$f$dPara["gamma"])
    dweibull(xs, shape = gam, scale = 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam))   # forceErrExpec: E[eps]=1
  } else {
    dexp(xs, rate = 1)
  }
  data.table(panel = s$label, x = xs, y = ys)
}))

ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(data = dens_plot_dat, aes(x = resid, y = after_stat(density)),
                  bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens_curve_dat, aes(x = x, y = y), colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title    = "Density overlay: standardised residuals vs theoretical distribution",
       subtitle = "Histogram = empirical eps_hat (trimmed at 99th pct); red = theoretical density (Exp(1) or Weibull(gamma_hat))",
       x = "Standardised residual (eps_hat = x / psi_hat)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Log acd exponential

## 3.6.1 Log-ACD Type I (LACD1)

```{r logacd-fit-setup}

#  Log-ACD (Bauwens & Giot 2000), type LACD1.

#  log psi_i = omega + alpha*log(eps_{i-1}) + beta*log psi_{i-1}
#  with eps_i = x_i / psi_i. Two consequences:
#   - Positivity of psi is automatic (it is exp of the log-recursion); no
#     parameter constraints are needed, unlike the linear ACD.
#   - alpha multiplies log(eps), and beta multiplies log(psi): NEITHER is on the
#     same scale as the linear-ACD alpha, beta.
#
# To see if the log structure fixes the near-zero-duration corruption.

#starting parameter vectors for optimiser.
logacd_seed1 <- c(0,    0.05, 0.90)
logacd_seed2 <- c(0,    0.02, 0.50)

# checks if logacd-fits exists already to avoid refitting.
logacd_asset_done <- function(nm)
  exists("logacd_fits", inherits = FALSE) && nm %in% names(logacd_fits)

# model fit function per asset.
fit_logacd_one <- function(nm) {
  x <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)
  cat(sprintf("\n Log-ACD (LACD1): %s (n = %s) \n",
              nm, format(length(x), big.mark = ",")))

  if (!requireNamespace("callr", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package 'callr' is required for crash-isolated Log-ACD fitting -- install.packages(\"callr\")")

  fit <- tryCatch(
    callr::r(function(x, seed1, seed2) {
      library(ACDm)
      attempt <- function(seed, use_nlminb, label) {
        cat(sprintf("  [subprocess] %s...\n", label))
        tryCatch(
          withCallingHandlers(
            if (use_nlminb)
              acdFit(durations = x, model = "LACD1", dist = "exponential", order = c(1, 1),
                     optimFnc = "nlminb", startPara = seed, output = FALSE)
            else
              acdFit(durations = x, model = "LACD1", dist = "exponential", order = c(1, 1),
                     startPara = seed, output = FALSE),
            warning = function(w)
              if (grepl("NA/NaN function evaluation", conditionMessage(w)))
                invokeRestart("muffleWarning")),
          error = function(e) { cat("  [subprocess] failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
      }
      f <- attempt(seed1, FALSE, "tier-1 seeded default optimiser")
      if (is.null(f)) f <- attempt(seed1, TRUE,  "tier-2 seeded nlminb (same seed)")
      if (is.null(f)) f <- attempt(seed2, TRUE,  "tier-3 nlminb, flatter/less persistent start")
      f
    }, args = list(x = x, seed1 = logacd_seed1, seed2 = logacd_seed2),
    timeout = 1800),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  subprocess crashed or timed out -- this session is UNAFFECTED:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    })

  # Loads model fitted from disk cache if not in session memory
  if (!exists("logacd_fits", inherits = FALSE)) {
    logacd_fits <<- if (file.exists(MODEL_CACHE_FILE)) {
      cached <- tryCatch(readRDS(MODEL_CACHE_FILE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(cached) && !is.null(cached$logacd_fits)) cached$logacd_fits else list()
    } else list()
  }
  logacd_fits[nm] <<- list(fit)  # stores result under asset name. 
  save_model_progress(logacd_fits = logacd_fits) # Writes to disk cache.
  invisible(fit)
}
```

```{r logacd-table}

#  omega/alpha1/beta1 here are on the LOG-RECURSION scale 
#  (log psi = omega + alpha1*log(eps) + beta1*log psi)
#  NOT comparable to EACD's linear
#  alpha+beta - persistence reporting stays with EACD, WACD

logacd_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(logacd_fits), function(nm) {
  f <- logacd_fits[[nm]]; p <- f$mPara
  e <- if (exists("eacd_fits", inherits = FALSE) && !is.null(eacd_fits[[nm]])) eacd_fits[[nm]] else NULL
  beta1 <- unname(p["beta1"])
  data.table(
    asset       = nm,
    omega       = round(unname(p["omega"]),  5),
    alpha1      = round(unname(p["alpha1"]), 4),
    beta1       = round(beta1, 4),
    persistence = round(beta1, 4),   # LACD1: |beta1| alone
    regime      = ifelse(abs(beta1) < 1, "stationary", "INTEGRATED/EXPLOSIVE"),
    logLik      = round(gof(f, "LogLikelihood"), 1),
    AIC         = round(gof(f, "AIC"), 1),
    BIC         = round(gof(f, "BIC"), 1),
    logLik_EACD = if (!is.null(e)) round(gof(e, "LogLikelihood"), 1) else NA_real_,
    AIC_EACD    = if (!is.null(e)) round(gof(e, "AIC"), 1) else NA_real_
  )
}))

cat("\n\n Log-ACD (LACD1) PARAMETER ESTIMATES \n\n")
print(logacd_tbl)

cat("\nPARAMETER INFERENCE (SE, t-value, p-value):\n")
for (nm in names(logacd_fits)) {
  cat("\n---", nm, "---\n")
  print(round(logacd_fits[[nm]]$parameterInference, 6))
}

#  LACD1's recursion is:
#  log(psi_i) = omega + alpha1*log(eps_i-1) + beta1*log(psi_i-1) 

#  alpha1 multiplies the INNOVATION log(eps), not a lagged log(psi) term, so it does not feed the 
#  recursion's own memory the way EACD's alpha does. persistence here is |beta1| ALONE (the log-
#  recursion's own AR coefficient), NOT alpha1+beta1. 
#  |beta1| < 1 is the stationarity condition.

#  logLik_EACD/AIC_EACD (same asset, same TRAIN data) is the fair basis for
#  comparing fit QUALITY across the two specifications: whichever model has
#  the lower AIC/BIC fits this series better. persistence and regime above
#  are a separate question - LACD1's own memory, not a rival estimate of
#  EACD's alpha+beta.

```

```{r logacd-residual-diagnostics}

#  SAME LOGIC AS eacd-residuals: eps_hat = x/psi_hat should be (a) Exp(1) and
#  (b) serially independent if the specification is correct.

logacd_diag_assets <- c("BTCUSDT", "NVDA")

qq_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(logacd_diag_assets, function(nm) {
  e     <- as.numeric(logacd_fits[[nm]]$residuals)
  e_tot <- length(e); e_bad <- sum(!is.finite(e) | e <= 0)
  e     <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d/%d residuals finite & positive (%d dropped)\n",
              nm, length(e), e_tot, e_bad))
  data.table(asset = nm, resid = e)
}))

if (nrow(qq_dat) == 0) {
  cat("\nNo finite positive residuals for BTCUSDT or NVDA - skipping Q-Q plot.\n")
  cat("Inspect logacd_fits[[nm]]$mPara / $residuals directly: this points to a\n")
  cat("degenerate LACD1 optimum, not a plotting bug.\n")
} else {
  print(
    ggplot(qq_dat, aes(sample = resid)) +
      stat_qq(distribution = qexp, size = 0.4, alpha = 0.15) +
      stat_qq_line(distribution = qexp, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
      facet_wrap(~ asset, scales = "free") +
      labs(title    = "Log-ACD (LACD1, exponential) residuals vs Exp(1)",
           subtitle = "Red line = perfect Exp(1) fit. Departure above the line = heavier right tail than exponential.",
           x = "Theoretical Exp(1) quantiles", y = "Sample residual quantiles") +
      theme_minimal()
  )
}

# Compute residuals

logacd_resid_diag <- setNames(lapply(logacd_diag_assets, function(nm) {
  e <- as.numeric(logacd_fits[[nm]]$residuals)
  e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  if (length(e) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: 0 finite positive residuals - acf()/Box.test()/ks.test() skipped.\n", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }
  list(acf = acf(e, lag.max = 50, plot = FALSE),
       lb  = Box.test(e, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box"),
       kt  = ks.test(e, "pexp", rate = 1),
       n   = length(e))
}), logacd_diag_assets)


logacd_diag_assets_ok <- logacd_diag_assets[!vapply(logacd_resid_diag, is.null, logical(1))] # applies only to non-null assets

if (length(logacd_diag_assets_ok) == 0) {
  cat("\nNeither BTCUSDT nor NVDA has usable Log-ACD residuals - ACF/Ljung-Box/KS all skipped.\n")
} else {

acf_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(logacd_diag_assets_ok, function(nm) {
  a <- logacd_resid_diag[[nm]]$acf
  data.table(asset = nm, lag = as.numeric(a$lag)[-1], acf = as.numeric(a$acf)[-1])
}))
ci_dat <- data.table(
  asset = logacd_diag_assets_ok,
  ci = qnorm(0.975) / sqrt(sapply(logacd_diag_assets_ok, function(nm) logacd_resid_diag[[nm]]$n))
)

print(
  ggplot(acf_dat, aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(data = ci_dat, aes(yintercept =  ci), linetype = "dashed", colour = "steelblue") +
    geom_hline(data = ci_dat, aes(yintercept = -ci), linetype = "dashed", colour = "steelblue") +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = lag, yend = 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~ asset) +
    labs(title    = "ACF of Log-ACD (LACD1) residuals",
         subtitle = "Dashed line = 95% white-noise band",
         x = "Lag", y = "ACF") +
    theme_minimal()
)

cat(" Log-ACD (LACD1) residual diagnostics: BTCUSDT & NVDA \n\n")
for (nm in logacd_diag_assets_ok) {
  d <- logacd_resid_diag[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("--- %s (n = %s) ---\n", nm, format(d$n, big.mark = ",")))
  cat(sprintf("  ACF lag 1-5        : %s\n",
              paste(round(d$acf$acf[2:6], 4), collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("  Ljung-Box (lag=%d)  : stat=%.2f, df=%d, p=%.3g  %s\n",
              LB_LAGS, unname(d$lb$statistic), unname(d$lb$parameter), d$lb$p.value,
              ifelse(d$lb$p.value < 0.05, "REJECT (autocorrelation remains)", "not rejected")))
  cat(sprintf("  KS vs Exp(1)        : D=%.4f, p=%.3g  %s\n\n",
              unname(d$kt$statistic), d$kt$p.value,
              ifelse(d$kt$p.value < 0.05, "REJECT Exp(1)", "not rejected")))
}

cat("READING IT: the mean equation is clean (residual mean ~1, logL<0, per\n")
cat("logacd-compare below), but the Q-Q plot's rightward bend above the red\n")
cat("line and the rejected KS test show the TAIL is heavier than Exp(1) on\n")
cat("both assets. The small but nonzero ACF at low lags and the Ljung-Box\n")
cat("rejection show a trace of serial dependence survives the fit --\n")
cat("consistent with eacd-residuals' finding that full independence is not\n")
cat("achieved anywhere on this ladder, and expected at the sample sizes here\n")
cat("(the full training window per asset, hundreds of thousands to millions\n")
cat("of observations -- Box.test's power to reject trivial autocorrelation\n")
cat("is high at this scale).\n")
}
```

```{r logacd-order-selection}

#  LACD1 ORDER SELECTION: all four orders - (1,1), (1,2), (2,1), (2,2) 
#  log psi_i = omega + sum_j alpha_j*log(eps_{i-j}) + sum_k beta_k*log(psi_{i-k}).

make_lacd_seed_22 <- function(nm) {
  p <- logacd_fits[[nm]]$mPara
  om <- unname(p["omega"]); a1 <- unname(p["alpha1"]); b1 <- unname(p["beta1"])
  c(om, a1 * 0.95, a1 * 0.05, b1 * 0.85, b1 * 0.15)
}

# Same 95/5 (alpha)  / 85/15 (beta) splitting convention as make_seed_asym
# (EACD/WACD), applied to LACD1(1,1)'s own converged solution.
make_lacd_seed_asym <- function(nm, order) {
  p <- logacd_fits[[nm]]$mPara
  om <- unname(p["omega"]); a1 <- unname(p["alpha1"]); b1 <- unname(p["beta1"])
  if (identical(order, c(1, 2))) c(om, a1, b1 * 0.85, b1 * 0.15)   # omega, alpha1, beta1, beta2
  else                            c(om, a1 * 0.95, a1 * 0.05, b1)  # omega, alpha1, alpha2, beta1
}

fit_lacd_order <- function(order, seed_fn) {
  if (!requireNamespace("callr", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package 'callr' is required for crash-isolated LACD1 order fitting -- install.packages(\"callr\")")
  fits <- list(); status <- list()
  for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
    x    <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)
    seed <- seed_fn(nm)
    cat(sprintf("\n=== LACD1%s: %s (n = %s) ===\n",
                paste0("(", order[1], ",", order[2], ")"), nm, format(length(x), big.mark = ",")))

    fit <- tryCatch(
      callr::r(function(x, order, seed) {
        library(ACDm)
        tryCatch(
          withCallingHandlers(
            acdFit(durations = x, model = "LACD1", dist = "exponential",
                   order = order, optimFnc = "nlminb", startPara = seed,
                   control = list(eval.max = 1000, iter.max = 800),
                   output = FALSE),
            warning = function(w) {
              if (grepl("NA/NaN function evaluation", conditionMessage(w)))
                invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
            }),
          error = function(e) { cat("  [subprocess] FAILED to converge:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
      }, args = list(x = x, order = order, seed = seed), timeout = 1800),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  subprocess crashed or timed out -- this session is UNAFFECTED:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })

    fits[nm]     <- list(fit)   # [nm]<-list() not [[nm]]<- : preserves a NULL (failed-fit) entry
    status[[nm]] <- if (is.null(fit)) "FAILED (crash, timeout, or over-parameterisation)" else "converged"
  }
  list(fits = fits, status = status)
}

# Fits only if not cached.

if (!fit_ready("logacd22_fits")) {
res22 <- fit_lacd_order(c(2, 2), make_lacd_seed_22)
logacd22_fits <- res22$fits

cat("\n=== LACD1(2,2) CONVERGENCE STATUS ===\n")
for (nm in names(res22$status)) cat(sprintf("  %-8s: %s\n", nm, res22$status[[nm]]))
save_model_progress(logacd22_fits = logacd22_fits)
}

if (!fit_ready("logacd12_fits") || !fit_ready("logacd21_fits")) {
res12l <- fit_lacd_order(c(1, 2), function(nm) make_lacd_seed_asym(nm, c(1, 2)))
logacd12_fits <- res12l$fits
res21l <- fit_lacd_order(c(2, 1), function(nm) make_lacd_seed_asym(nm, c(2, 1)))
logacd21_fits <- res21l$fits

cat("\n=== LACD1(1,2) CONVERGENCE STATUS ===\n")
for (nm in names(res12l$status)) cat(sprintf("  %-8s: %s\n", nm, res12l$status[[nm]]))
cat("\n=== LACD1(2,1) CONVERGENCE STATUS ===\n")
for (nm in names(res21l$status)) cat(sprintf("  %-8s: %s\n", nm, res21l$status[[nm]]))
save_model_progress(logacd12_fits = logacd12_fits, logacd21_fits = logacd21_fits)
}

#  ORDER-SELECTION GRID: LACD1, all four orders, exponential.

logacd_order_fits <- list("(1,1)" = logacd_fits, "(1,2)" = logacd12_fits,
                           "(2,1)" = logacd21_fits, "(2,2)" = logacd22_fits)
logacd_order_k    <- c("(1,1)" = 3, "(1,2)" = 4, "(2,1)" = 4, "(2,2)" = 5)
logacd_order_crit <- c("(1,2)" = 3.84, "(2,1)" = 3.84, "(2,2)" = 5.99)

# Persistence 

logacd_persist_of <- function(f) {
  p <- f$mPara
  # BETA ONLY, not alpha+beta: verified empirically (ACF of the simulated
  # log-psi process decays at beta^k, not (alpha+beta)^k - alpha multiplies
  # log(eps_{i-j}), which is the STANDARDISED residual, independent of
  # psi_{i-j} by construction (unlike EACD/WACD's x_{i-1}=psi_{i-1}*eps_{i-1},
  # which genuinely carries psi_{i-1}'s level forward). Only beta*log(psi)
  # feeds the log-psi state back into itself.
  unname(sum(p[grepl("^beta", names(p))]))
}

if (!exists("gof", inherits = FALSE))  gof  <- function(f, what) f$goodnessOfFit[what, "value"]
if (!exists("lb15", inherits = FALSE)) lb15 <- function(f, sq = FALSE, p = FALSE) {
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  if (length(e) <= LB_LAGS) return(NA_real_)
  bt <- Box.test(if (sq) e^2 else e, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  if (p) return(bt$p.value)
  unname(bt$statistic)
}

logacd_order_grid <- rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm) {
  rbindlist(lapply(names(logacd_order_fits), function(ord) {
    f <- logacd_order_fits[[ord]][[nm]]
    na_row <- function(verdict) data.table(
      asset = nm, order = ord, k = logacd_order_k[[ord]],
      logLik = NA_real_, AIC = NA_real_, BIC = NA_real_,
      persist_log_scale = NA_real_, LB_resid = NA_real_,
      LR = NA_real_, LR_crit = NA_real_, verdict = verdict)
    if (is.null(f)) return(na_row("FAILED to converge"))

    row <- tryCatch({
      ll <- gof(f, "LogLikelihood")
      lr <- lr_crit <- NA_real_; verdict <- "-- baseline --"
      if (ord != "(1,1)") {
        lr      <- 2 * (ll - gof(logacd_fits[[nm]], "LogLikelihood"))
        lr_crit <- logacd_order_crit[[ord]]
        verdict <- ifelse(lr > lr_crit, "sig. better than (1,1)", "NOT sig. better than (1,1)")
      }
      data.table(asset = nm, order = ord, k = logacd_order_k[[ord]],
                 logLik = round(ll, 1), AIC = round(gof(f, "AIC"), 1), BIC = round(gof(f, "BIC"), 1),
                 persist_log_scale = round(logacd_persist_of(f), 4), LB_resid = round(lb15(f), 1),
                 LR = round(lr, 2), LR_crit = lr_crit, verdict = verdict)
    }, error = function(e) {
      # PRINT the real error rather than silently falling through to a
      # generic "degenerate" verdict -- a genuinely fine fit hitting a
      # missing-helper-function error (e.g. gof()/lb15() not yet in scope
      # this session) looks IDENTICAL to real numerical degeneracy unless
      # the actual message is surfaced here.
      cat(sprintf("  [%s %s] grid-row error: %s\n", nm, ord, conditionMessage(e)))
      NULL
    })

    # A fit can exist without erroring yet still be degenerate -- report that too.
    if (is.null(row) || !is.finite(row$logLik)) return(na_row("converged but degenerate (non-finite fit)"))
    row
  }))
}))

for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== LACD1 ORDER SELECTION GRID: %s ===\n\n", nm))
  sub <- logacd_order_grid[asset == nm]
  print(sub, row.names = FALSE)
  if (all(is.finite(sub$AIC))) {
    cat(sprintf("  Best by AIC: %s | Best by BIC: %s\n",
                sub$order[which.min(sub$AIC)], sub$order[which.min(sub$BIC)]))
  }
}

cat("\nREADING IT: as with EACD's own order-selection grid (eacd-order-selection),\n")
cat("this asks whether LR/AIC/BIC settle on (1,1) or push toward richer orders,\n")
cat("and whether any higher order fails to converge -- itself evidence the extra\n")
cat("parameters are not identified at that order. persist_log_scale is on the\n")
cat("LOG scale -- compare orders WITHIN this table only, not against the\n")
cat("EACD/WACD linear alpha+beta reported elsewhere in this notebook.\n")
```

```{r logacd-order-full-table}

logacd_full_row <- function(nm, ord, f) {
  na_row <- function(verdict, n = NA_integer_, extra = list())
    do.call(data.table, c(list(
      asset = nm, order = ord, n = n, omega = NA_real_,
      alpha1 = NA_real_, alpha2 = NA_real_, beta1 = NA_real_, beta2 = NA_real_,
      persist_log_scale = NA_real_, logLik = NA_real_, AIC = NA_real_, BIC = NA_real_,
      mean_resid = NA_real_, mean_resid_z = NA_real_, sd_resid = NA_real_,
      disp_stat = NA_real_, exponential = NA_character_,
      LB_resid = NA_real_, LB_resid_p = NA_real_, LB_resid_sq = NA_real_, LB_resid_sq_p = NA_real_,
      verdict = verdict), extra))

  if (is.null(f)) return(na_row("FAILED to converge"))
  p <- f$mPara
  e <- as.numeric(f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]; n <- length(e)
  if (n <= LB_LAGS) return(na_row("degenerate (too few finite residuals for LB)", n = n))

  # Ljung box test on residuals and sq. residuals.
  
  lb1_t <- Box.test(e,   lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  lb2_t <- Box.test(e^2, lag = LB_LAGS, type = "Ljung-Box")
  
  # Excess dispersion z-stat
  
  s2 <- var(e); sig_u <- sd((e - 1)^2); disp <- sqrt(n) * (s2 - 1) / sig_u

  data.table(
    asset = nm, order = ord, n = n,
    omega  = round(unname(p["omega"]), 5),
    alpha1 = round(unname(p["alpha1"]), 4),
    alpha2 = if ("alpha2" %in% names(p)) round(unname(p["alpha2"]), 4) else NA_real_,
    beta1  = round(unname(p["beta1"]), 4),
    beta2  = if ("beta2" %in% names(p)) round(unname(p["beta2"]), 4) else NA_real_,
    persist_log_scale = round(logacd_persist_of(f), 4),
    logLik = round(gof(f, "LogLikelihood"), 1), AIC = round(gof(f, "AIC"), 1), BIC = round(gof(f, "BIC"), 1),
    mean_resid = round(mean(e), 4), mean_resid_z = round(resid_mean_z(e), 1), sd_resid = round(sd(e), 4),
    disp_stat = round(disp, 1), exponential = ifelse(abs(disp) > 1.96, "REJECTED", "not rejected"),
    LB_resid = round(unname(lb1_t$statistic), 1), LB_resid_p = signif(lb1_t$p.value, 3),
    LB_resid_sq = round(unname(lb2_t$statistic), 1), LB_resid_sq_p = signif(lb2_t$p.value, 3),
    verdict = "ok"
  )
}

logacd_full_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(logacd_order_fits), function(ord)
  rbindlist(lapply(names(split_sets), function(nm)
    logacd_full_row(nm, ord, logacd_order_fits[[ord]][[nm]])))), fill = TRUE)

cat("=== LACD1, ALL FOUR ORDERS: parameters, AIC/BIC, residual diagnostics ===\n\n")
print(logacd_full_tbl, row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}

suppressMessages({ library(data.table); library(ggplot2) })

dens_specs <- list(
  list(label = "LACD(2,2) -- GBP/USD", f = logacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["GBP/USD"]], dist = "exponential"),
  list(label = "LACD2(2,2) -- BTCUSDT", f = logacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["BTCUSDT"]], dist = "exponential"),
  list(label = "LACD2(2,2) -- NVDA",    f = logacd_order_fits[["(2,2)"]][["NVDA"]],    dist = "exponential")
)

# Empirical residuals, trimmed at the 99th percentile per spec (a few
# extreme residuals otherwise squash the histogram's x-axis and hide the
# body of the distribution, which is what this plot is meant to show).
dens_plot_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(dens_specs, function(s) {
  if (is.null(s$f)) { cat(sprintf("%s: NO CONVERGED FIT -- skipped.\n", s$label)); return(NULL) }
  e <- as.numeric(s$f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cap <- quantile(e, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  data.table(panel = s$label, resid = e[e <= cap])
}))

# Theoretical density curve, same distribution/params each fit actually used.
dens_curve_dat <- rbindlist(lapply(dens_specs, function(s) {
  if (is.null(s$f)) return(NULL)
  e <- as.numeric(s$f$residuals); e <- e[is.finite(e) & e > 0]
  cap <- quantile(e, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  xs <- seq(0.001, cap, length.out = 300)
  ys <- if (s$dist == "weibull") {
    gam <- unname(s$f$dPara["gamma"])
    dweibull(xs, shape = gam, scale = 1 / gamma(1 + 1 / gam))   # forceErrExpec: E[eps]=1
  } else {
    dexp(xs, rate = 1)
  }
  data.table(panel = s$label, x = xs, y = ys)
}))

ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(data = dens_plot_dat, aes(x = resid, y = after_stat(density)),
                  bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens_curve_dat, aes(x = x, y = y), colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title    = "Density overlay: standardised residuals vs theoretical distribution",
       subtitle = "Histogram = empirical eps_hat (trimmed at 99th pct); red = theoretical density (Exp(1) or Weibull(gamma_hat))",
       x = "Standardised residual (eps_hat = x / psi_hat)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## 3.6.2 Log-ACD Type II (LACD2) — the more widely used specification

Bauwens & Giot (2000) describe two log-linear mean specifications. LACD1
(fitted above) feeds `log(eps_i-1)` - the log of the PREVIOUS standardised
residual - into the recursion. LACD2 instead feeds `eps_i-1` itself,
unlogged:

$$\log\psi_i = \omega + \alpha_1\,\varepsilon_{i-1} + \beta_1\log\psi_{i-1},
\qquad \varepsilon_i = x_i/\psi_i$$

Only $\beta_1$ multiplies a lagged $\log\psi$ term, so persistence here is $|\beta_1|$
alone, not $\alpha_1+\beta_1$, and the two specifications' persistence
figures ARE comparable to each other (both are the log-recursion's own AR
coefficient), unlike either against EACD/WACD's linear alpha+beta.

```{r logacd2-fit-setup}

fit_logacd2_one <- function(nm) {
  if (!requireNamespace("callr", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package 'callr' is required for crash-isolated LACD2 fitting -- install.packages(\"callr\")")
  x <- get_fit_series(nm, FIT_N)
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Log-ACD (LACD2): %s (n = %s) ===\n",
              nm, format(length(x), big.mark = ",")))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    callr::r(function(x, seed1, seed2) {
      library(ACDm)
      attempt <- function(seed, use_nlminb, label) {
        cat(sprintf("  [subprocess] %s...\n", label))
        tryCatch(
          withCallingHandlers(
            if (use_nlminb)
              acdFit(durations = x, model = "LACD2", dist = "exponential", order = c(1, 1),
                     optimFnc = "nlminb", startPara = seed, output = FALSE)
            else
              acdFit(durations = x, model = "LACD2", dist = "exponential", order = c(1, 1),
                     startPara = seed, output = FALSE),
            warning = function(w)
              if (grepl("NA/NaN function evaluation", conditionMessage(w)))
                invokeRestart("muffleWarning")),
          error = function(e) { cat("  [subprocess] failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
      }
      f <- attempt(seed1, FALSE, "tier-1 seeded default optimiser")
      if (is.null(f)) f <- attempt(seed1, TRUE,  "tier-2 seeded nlminb (same seed)")
      if (is.null(f)) f <- attempt(seed2, TRUE,  "tier-3 nlminb, flatter/less persistent start")
      f
    }, args = list(x = x, seed1 = logacd_seed1, seed2 = logacd_seed2), timeout = 1800),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  subprocess crashed or timed out -- this session is UNAFFECTED:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    })
  fit
}

if (!fit_ready("logacd2_fits")) {
logacd2_fits <- list()
for (nm in names(split_sets)) {
  logacd2_fits[nm] <- list(fit_logacd2_one(nm))   # [nm]<-list() not [[nm]]<- : preserves a NULL entry
}
save_model_progress(logacd2_fits = logacd2_fits)
}

cat(sprintf("\n%s converged: %s\n", length(logacd2_fits), paste(names(logacd2_fits), collapse = ", ")))
```

```{r logacd2-table}
  beta1 <- unname(p["beta1"])

    AIC_EACD    = if (!is.null(e)) round(gof(e, "AIC"), 1) else NA_real_
  )
}))
```

```{r logacd2-residual-diagnostics}
}))

           x = "Theoretical Exp(1) quantiles", y = "Sample residual quantiles") +
```
